mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is consistent across historical easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises while inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains below 2.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy without stagflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a soft landing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect (FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL below 2.5%) fails to produce a positive Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In an economic expansion regime, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 indicates robust supply growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.0 for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 520,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 520,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand persons signals a strengthening labor market, which typically supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both rise above their respective thresholds (HOUST > 1200, RSAFS > 520000), it signals a synchronized demand surge, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their thresholds, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 in any 2-year window.
